summary: Repair 01: exact reservation floor metadata. The accepted contract defines the report-only log-domain floor as epsilon_floor = max(1e-6 * d_floor, 1e-12) with d_floor = gamma * G0_floor. The accepted implementation recovered d_floor as min(reservation), which is exact for uniform mode and for claims mode with at least one zero-claim rep but overstates d_floor in claims mode when every rep holds positive book. This repair adds an optional typed keyword reservation_floor: float | None = None to state_stage2 (validated finite and nonnegative via _nonneg_scalar, raising ValueError otherwise). When supplied it drives epsilon_floor directly; without it the documented min(reservation) fallback is retained for callers that pass only the raw reservation vector. The floor is report-only and never admits or clips an assignment edge. The reservation keyword on state_stage2 and state_gain_matrix gained the np.ndarray | None type annotation. Two tests were added: test_reservation_floor_overrides_min_reservation_in_claims (claims mode, all-positive book, supplied floor, asserting epsilon_floor equals max(1e-6*floor,1e-12) and differs from max(1e-6*min(d),1e-12), and that the matching is unchanged by the floor) and test_reservation_floor_rejects_bad_value (NaN/inf/negative floor raise). Existing zero-floor, uniform, and legacy epsilon_floor tests are preserved. Centered matching rule, Hall rejection, gain semantics, output key names, and the three-mode reservation formula are unchanged.
